title: Fix Icon Catalog Gaps: Missing SVGs And Typegen Derive
description:
Pre-existing, unrelated infrastructure gaps in the icon system discovered during the PROTOCOL-BINARY-OP-LOG-LAYER Wave R rename sweep (protocol -> playbook), filed as a dedicated follow-up per that ticket's closing summary.

1. `ui/asset/icon/generated/icon_name.rs` (gitignored, regenerated from `ui/asset/icon/*.svg` by `ui/asset/script.ts`) is missing SVG source files for several icon ids that real application code already references as string literals, e.g. "building" (used by playbook/module/procedural/rs/lib.rs and framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs's test fixture), "help-circle" and "sticky-note" (used by forms/plugin/rs/lib.rs's catalogue_kinds fallback). IconName::from(&str) (around line 1380 of the generated file) does Self::from_str(value).expect("invalid catalog icon name") and panics at runtime whenever one of these strings is used. This currently breaks tests: playbook-module-procedural (module_manifest_contributes_building_component, params_body_includes_media_export_buttons, params_body_lists_flow_inputs), forms-plugin (catalogue_lists_question_kinds, extension_question_emits_external_slot_when_contribution_registered, document_lists_steps, document_tree_declares_drop_action, drop_question_kind_inserts_and_selects, blueprint_builder_card_reflects_selection, forms_labels_resolve_native_english_by_default, forms_labels_resolve_german_locale, renders_blueprint_builder_cards), procedural-plugin (procedural3d_labels_resolve_native_english_by_default, procedural3d_labels_translate_catalogue_and_inspector_in_german), and semio-framework-os (host::tests::contributions_track_plugin_load_and_hot_swap). Fix: find the FULL gap (grep all icon id string literals referenced across the codebase vs what's in icon_name.rs's FromStr impl, not just the three examples above), add the missing SVG source files under ui/asset/icon/*.svg (handcrafted, no placeholders/migrations per repo rules), then regenerate via ui/asset/script.ts's generate command.

2. IconName (same generated file) has no #[cfg_attr(feature = "typegen", derive(ts_rs::TS))], unlike other types that participate in the framework-core -> TypeScript mirror. This means `bun nx run @semio-tech/framework-core:generate` fails to compile ui_wgpu with --features typegen (error: the trait bound IconName: TS is not satisfied, at ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs:518 where BlockPaletteEntry.icon_id: IconName is used under a #[derive(ts_rs::TS)] struct). This blocks regenerating framework/core/js/generated/manifest.ts entirely. Fix: update ui/asset/script.ts's icon-catalog generator to also emit the ts-rs derive (feature-gated like the rest of the codebase's typegen pattern) and an appropriate TS export, then re-run both the icon generator and bun nx run @semio-tech/framework-core:generate.

After fixing both, check whether framework/core/js/generated/manifest.ts still contains a stale "kind": "protocolBlockKind" entry for the Contribution type (it should say "playbookBlockKind" since framework/core/rs/lib.rs's Contribution::PlaybookBlockKind variant was already renamed in Wave R, but the generated TS mirror couldn't be refreshed due to blocker #2). If stale, running the generator should fix it automatically once IconName compiles under typegen.

Confirm all previously-panicking tests now pass by actually running them, not by assumption.
